videos.caption: Water first. Substrate second. 💧🌱 This is personally my favorite way to add substrate, especially for a no CO₂, no-filter aquarium. I start with about 2 cm of water, then add the substrate directly into it. The water immediately traps most of the fine particles, instead of letting a cloud of dust spread everywhere. I also don’t rinse my substrate, because I prefer to keep everything it contains rather than washing part of the fine material away. Less dust. Less mess. Nothing wasted. Must haves for your tank. Tap water conditioner and Sludge destroyer. The additives in tap water suck as chlorine are harmful to your babies. Chlorine can cause health issues and deformities to your turtles shell, this is why you use water conditioner. If you have a large tank, get the super strength water conditioner, smaller tanks like a 20 or 40 gallon tank, you can start off with regular strength. You also need to have the sludge destroyer. This helps break down waste and debris like food particles in the tank. To be clear, sludge destroyer is a clearish liquid that has good bacteria to help your tank. With every water change, you want to add these to your tank. I hope this helps someone who is new to turtle life! #turtle #update #todo #aquaticlife #happyfriday
